title: Sort Characters by frequency
problemStatement: Sort the characters of a string in decreasing order of frequency.
intuition: Count first, then order the distinct characters by count. With a small alphabet, bucket sort makes it linear.

approaches.title: Count + sort
approaches.idea: Sort the distinct characters by descending count.

approaches.title: Bucket sort by count
approaches.idea: Counts are bounded by n, so bucket by frequency for O(n).
approaches.whyWorks: Frequencies live in [1, n], so they can index an array instead of being compared.

edgeCases: Ties in frequency (any order is usually accepted)
commonMistakes: Sorting the whole string instead of the distinct characters
Forgetting to repeat each character count times
patternRecognition: Bounded integer keys -> bucket/counting sort beats comparison sort
followUps: Rearrange so no two adjacent characters match
interviewInsight: Naming bucket sort as the linear alternative is what turns a fine answer into a strong one.
